brief:
Israeli Minister of Diaspora Affairs Amichai Chikli launched a sharp critique of European political elites, the Shehab Wire reported, claiming that a significant portion of the continent's leadership has embraced what he termed "post-nationalist extremism." Chikli attributed this ideological shift to what he described as "excessive sympathy" directed toward Palestinian causes and Islamic movements.

The minister's comments reflect deepening friction between Israel's government and European capitals over their diverging stances on the Israeli-Palestinian conflict. European nations have increasingly faced criticism from Israeli officials over statements and policies perceived as supportive of Palestinian rights and critical of Israeli military operations.
